case_name: Younge v. Fulton Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office
title: Rules that look past the pleadings
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

cue.heading: Rules that look past the pleadings

compare.title: Issues tried by consent
compare.text: When an issue not raised by the pleadings is tried by the parties’ express or implied consent, it must be <mark>treated in all respects as if raised in the pleadings</mark>. … But failure to amend does not affect the result of the trial of that issue.

compare.title: Relief in a judgment
compare.text: Every other final judgment should grant the relief to which each party is entitled, <mark>even if the party has not demanded that relief</mark> in its pleadings.
